title: Jensen Huang pulls out of ElevenLabs Summit amid Nvidia controversy
original_title: Jensen Huang pulls out of ElevenLabs Summit amid Nvidia controversy
summary: The Nvidia CEO also pulled out of an Anthropic event earlier.
title_zh: 黄仁勋因争议退出 ElevenLabs 峰会
lead_zh: 报道称，在英伟达相关争议持续之际，首席执行官黄仁勋退出了 ElevenLabs Summit，并且此前也已退出一场 Anthropic 的活动。
